newsitem.title: USA: INSTANT VIEW -- IBM Q4 earnings.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW -- IBM Q4 earnings.

text.p: International Business Machines Corp reported fourth quarter earnings on Tuesday of $3.93 a share, compared to $3.09 a year ago.
Wall Street's consensus estimate was for $3.88 a share, according to First Call.
ARNIE OWEN, DIRECTOR OF EQUITIES AT KAUFMAN BROTHERS:
-- "I can't see how they'd punish them with these numbers but any stock that's been this straight up can see some profit taking."
-- "On the surface it looks okay with hardware revenues looking good, up two percent. It's a giant mixed bag, not spectacular but it cannot be construed as a negative."
IBM's shares traded at 168, off 1-3/8 from its New York Stock Exchange close, in after hours action.
THOM BROWN, MANAGING DIRECTOR OF RUTHERFORD BROWN AND CATHERWOOD:

-- The IBM earnings per share number "was a nickel higher than the First Call consensus (but) it's lower than some people were hoping. I don't think it's going to have a giant impact on the stock one way or another."

-- "It's an excellent number, it's an excellent quarter. You really can't say anything bad about it. But I think it may cause a brief period of selling because Wall Street (sells) on that kind of news... I don't get the feeling that we're going to get more exuberance in the price, but in the long term that is a very good number. It's an excellent performance.
-- "The growth in the services business was extradorinarily strong. That's also a good sign."
A WALL STREET TECHNOLOGY STOCK TRADER:
-- "It's obviously a little better than the Street was looking for. The reaction is to sell the stock. There is nothing to drive the stock. You're going to get that from anybody."
"It's a good number, no matter how you break it down, and there is nothing to drive the stock."
